description.value: The Thirsty Vintner is a winemaking kit shop that has operated at the same Shelbourne Street location in Victoria for over 25 years, offering customers the choice of making wine on-site with staff guidance or purchasing Winexpert kits to craft at home. The shop carries an extensive range spanning reds, whites, rosés, fruit wines, and oak-barrel aged varieties from wine regions around the world. Staff speak English, Cantonese, Mandarin, French, and Tagalog, making it an unusually welcoming stop for a diverse range of visitors.
